turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to start learning a new language this year.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great goal. Is there a language you need for work or travel, or would you rather pick one just because it sounds fun?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Give me a second, my brother needs help with something. Stay quiet until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait, what was the name of that Vietnamese place we went to with your sister?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The one with the huge bowls of pho?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes! I want to take my coworkers there.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I think it was called Little Saigon, near the train station.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it big enough for six people?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: There's a long table in the back. Call ahead though.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, I'm back. What was I saying?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. You were picking a language to learn this year.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Japanese, honestly just because I love the culture.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Wonderful. Learn the two kana alphabets first, they make everything else easier.
